issues.what: SVG diagram labels hint at the correct answer
issues.detail: The diagram shows a dashed line between Argo CD and K8s Cluster with the red text 'blocked?' and the label 'Sync Policy: ?' at the bottom. The dashed/blocked visual cue combined with the explicit 'Sync Policy: ?' text directly points the test-taker to option B ('The application sync policy is set to manual rather than automated') without requiring any Argo CD knowledge.
issues.suggestion: Remove the 'Sync Policy: ?' label and the 'blocked?' annotation. Instead, show the same three-box architecture (Git Repo -> Argo CD -> K8s Cluster) with a generic question mark or 'Why no auto-deploy?' text that does not directly reference sync policy.
